Install from lockfile (ignores committed:
- name: Install from lockfile (ignores committed node_modules)
        id: install
        run: rm -rf node_modules server/node_modules client/node_modules && npm ci
Install Playwright test dependency witho:
- name: Install Playwright test dependency without changing the lockfile
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund playwright@1.56.0
Install Chromium for the browser tests:
- name: Install Chromium for the browser tests
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: npx playwright install chromium
Verify Chromium can launch; install syst:
- name: Verify Chromium can launch; install system libraries if needed
        timeout-minutes: 5
        shell: bash
        run: |
          probe='import {chromium} from "playwright"; const browser=await chromium.launch({headless:true,args:["--no-sandbox"]}); await browser.close();'
          if ! node --input-type=module -e "$probe"; then
            npx playwright install-deps chromium
            node --input-type=module -e "$probe"
          fi

Publish test summary to claude/ci-result:
- name: Publish test summary to claude/ci-results (push events only)
        if: always() && github.event_name == 'push'
        env:
          CHECKER_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.test_checker.outcome }}
          SUITE_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.full_suite.outcome }}
          PRIOR_GATES: "install=${{ steps.install.outcome }}; build=${{ steps.build.outcome }}; browser=${{ steps.browser.outcome }}; quote=${{ steps.quote_gate.outcome }}"
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/ci && cd /tmp/ci
          git clone -q --depth 1 --branch claude/ci-results "https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" . 2>/dev/null || { git init -q && git checkout -q -b claude/ci-results; }
          name="$(echo "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" | tr '/' '_').txt"
          node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/verification/release-candidate-20261012l/render-test-summary.mjs" > "$name"
          git config user.name ci-bot && git config user.email ci-bot@users.noreply.github.com
          git add "$name"
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -q -m "CI ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} ${GITHUB_SHA::7}"
          fi
          git push -q "https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" HEAD:claude/ci-results
          echo 'Test summary publication completed.'
